name: OpenHands
description: Self-hosted control center for running the OpenHands software engineering agent, or other ACP coding agents, on local, Docker, VM or cloud backends.
whatItDoes: OpenHands gives developers and teams an autonomous engineer that can read a codebase, edit files, run commands and deliver changes. Its Agent Canvas app lets you start, watch and automate agent sessions, and can also host other ACP-compatible agents. Automations can be triggered from tools such as Slack, GitHub and Linear.
howItWorks: A web front end talks to a backend that launches agent sessions in a chosen execution environment (local machine, Docker, virtual machine or cloud). The agent runs a tool loop against any configured LLM, executing shell and file operations inside that environment. Front end and backend can be started together or separately.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.description: Python tooling used by the backend

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Credentials for whichever model provider the agent should use

models: Any LLM provider; also hosts ACP agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI
